read_requests.purpose: Resolve a bare immutable event UUID and its exact parent without scanning tags

permissions.read: history.read AND (physical_code.assign_rfid OR inventory.trace) AND active account/session AND confirmed warehouse context/scope
permissions.actor_and_reason: Additional audit_log.view; otherwise actor/reason are null with REDACTED
permissions.warehouse_scope: Persisted EVENT snapshot warehouse before totals, not current tag location
permissions.tenant: Actor and warehouse explicit tenant/org columns must agree; audit discriminator requires a matching trusted scope. Snapshot dimensions must match; unresolved source tenancy fails closed.
permissions.cache: private, no-store; client isolate actor/session/warehouse/filter/caller; discard stale callbacks

search.policy: Case-insensitive literal substring of persisted snapshot strings; outer whitespace trimmed; %, _ and ! escaped. No formatting normalization of UID, no reason/actor/payload search, no per-tag fan-out or page-local filtering.

filters.source: NFC only in opt-in mode; omitted defaults NFC
filters.replacement: ASSIGN_ITEM_NFC with captured verified distinct old/new tag UUID+UID and identical item+event warehouse. Identity strings must be nonblank. No inference from prefix or current status. P07 replacement remains disabled.
filters.status: Exact original owner result captured in after_data.nfc_history_v1.result, not the compatibility view result. ALL skips filtering; UNKNOWN selects missing/null/non-string snapshot result. Action/type/tag status are separate. No synthesized SUCCESS.
filters.date_mode: ALL default: no date fields; DATE: date; RANGE: from/to inclusive local calendar days using app timezone and exclusive next-day boundary
filters.timezone: Response meta.timezone is authoritative; app timezone normally Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh

result_provenance.source: Authenticated owner result argument captured before audit sanitization, legacy storage normalization and outbox fallback
result_provenance.storage_default: The existing PostgreSQL audit_log compatibility trigger maps NULL result to SUCCESS. P22 must not treat that default as proof of a successful physical operation.
result_provenance.legacy: Older snapshots without original result remain status=null/NOT_RECORDED even when audit_log.result is SUCCESS; no backfill and no SQL-trigger changes.
result_provenance.not_receipt: Even an explicitly recorded SUCCESS is an audit result, not P07 confirmation or hardware readback evidence.

pagination.sort: audit created_at DESC (null last), audit event id DESC; one immutable audit event per row even for the same tag
pagination.consistency: Upper time bound, not a frozen multi-request snapshot. Late outbox publication/permission changes may require restart. Keep totals from server; never data.length as total or EOF.
pagination.retry: Same read request permitted; expired/invalid cursor restarts first page, never repeat a write

projection.list: data[]; canonical recordId/activityId/eventId and whitelisted event snapshot only
projection.detail: data.recordId + data.selectedActivity + data.events containing exactly the selected event
projection.summary: data.grandTotal/availableTotal/typeTotals/statusTotals; countUnit EVENT within supported authorized persisted snapshot scope
projection.null_policy: Missing fields remain null; no current user/product/tag/warehouse fallback
projection.raw_content: Always null NOT_EXPOSED_MAY_CONTAIN_SECRETS; never whole audit JSON, written_payload, request bodies, idempotency keys or auth identifiers
projection.copy: Only actual returned UID, previous UID and serial; plain-text UI, not executable HTML

p07_dependency.capture: Additive logging only inside existing authenticated ASSIGN_ITEM_NFC/REVOKE_ITEM_NFC owner transaction, before audit sanitization and outbox fallback; exact actor, current confirmed warehouse and persisted tag/item relationships. Original result argument is captured without defaulting. No new event or writer endpoint.
p07_dependency.legacy: Do not backfill history from current tags. Old audit rows without event-level snapshot are excluded even if P08 legacy previously included them. P22 total can therefore differ from P08 legacy NFC count.
p07_dependency.outbox: Snapshot retained in outbox payload; P22 reads only published audit_log entries, not pending outbox or P07 receipts. Coverage is not a claim that all physical operations were published.
p07_dependency.replacement: Read support only when historical snapshot has proof; no enabling P07 replace_existing or hardware workflow
p07_dependency.receipt: Use original P07 confirmation contract for unknown writes; P22 list/current mapping never substitutes for it

error_mapping.200_total_zero: Verified empty authorized snapshot scope only; not a source outage
error_mapping.503_HISTORY_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: Missing source schema; do not map to empty or zero totals
error_mapping.401: Owner authentication/session recovery; clear protected snapshot
error_mapping.403: Owner history/source/warehouse permissions; do not retry a forbidden source as another owner
error_mapping.409: Confirmed warehouse context inactive/mismatch; follow owner context recovery
error_mapping.404_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: Missing/foreign event or wrong parent binding; no first-event fallback
error_mapping.422: Invalid/unsupported query, body on GET, or invalid/expired/scope-mismatched cursor
error_mapping.network: Transport failure is a client offline/error state, not a successful response or source 503

client_integration.transport: GET query parameters only, no JSON body; attach the opt-in header to each P22 request and verify response meta.contract
client_integration.paging: Paged adapter using server total/hasMore/nextCursor; reset cursor on supported filter changes; no full-array fixture, fan-out, local page filtering or guessed IDs
client_integration.state: Keep copy/reader/scroll/IME behavior; key state to actor/auth session/warehouse/query and discard superseded responses
client_integration.pending_controls: Disable or omit uncontracted raw JSON/export/hardware/mutation controls; missing or redacted fields remain explicit partial data

acceptance_pending: BA field/type/privacy and legacy coverage approval
Owner snapshot/outbox fault and concurrency acceptance
Release artifact and runtime-overlay reconciliation including timestamp storage/timezone
Authenticated read/deny/tenant/cursor/event smoke on allowed real data
Native UI paging/copy/scroll/IME/session and partial-detail UAT
live_prohibitions: No seed or assignment/revocation to manufacture evidence
Do not remove existing owner gates
test_scope: Fourteen P22 HTTP/provenance tests with synthetic isolated audit fixtures plus unchanged P07/P08 owner regressions; both SQLite/PostgreSQL and route-cached reads. CI results are not live/hardware or full-release evidence.
